UPDATE leads l
JOIN (
  SELECT leadId, MIN(dueDate) as earliest_due
  FROM follow_ups
  WHERE status = 'Pending'
  GROUP BY leadId
) f ON l.id = f.leadId
SET l.followUpDate = f.earliest_due
WHERE l.followUpDate IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) as migrated FROM leads WHERE followUpDate IS NOT NULL;
